install.command: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config clang cmake libhwloc-dev libudev-dev libssl-dev && (command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain 1.91.1 -c rustfmt -c clippy) && ([ -f "$HOME/.cargo/env" ] && . "$HOME/.cargo/env") && rustup toolchain install 1.91.1 --component rustfmt,clippy && (command -v helm >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash) && cargo fetch
